title: Self Custody Is Dead. Long Live Self Custody
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Self Custody Is Dead. Long Live Self Custody

The Coldcard security failure has shaken Bitcoin's confidence in hardware wallets—but abandoning self-custody would mean abandoning the very reason Bitcoin exists. History suggests the lesson isn't to trust custodians again, but to build stronger, more resilient ways to hold our own keys.

This post Self Custody Is Dead. Long Live Self Custody first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt.

title: Asset Manager 3iQ to Manage Bhutan’s Bitcoin Reserves
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Asset Manager 3iQ to Manage Bhutan’s Bitcoin Reserves

Canadian digital asset manager 3iQ Corp. will work to manage some of the Bitcoin reserves of Bhutan’s Gelephu Mindfulness City project.  3iQ, Canada’s biggest and oldest digital asset fund manager, will not only manage the 10,000 Bitcoins pledged to build the new region, but also invest in local talent and establish a long-term physical presence […]

This post Asset Manager 3iQ to Manage Bhutan’s Bitcoin Reserves first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo.
